prompts.coast:
Art direction: BULLETS OF FURY — OVERDRIVE. Match the supplied campaign island's richly detailed yet crisp 16-bit pixel art: tiny deliberate clustered pixels, near-black outlines, weathered military steel, restrained highlights, isometric overhead miniature world-map perspective. No smooth painted gradients, no vector art, no 3D-render look, no text, labels, numbered markers, logos, UI frames or routes drawn over the image. New original game art. Create ONE large transparent campaign-map LAND PLATE of Miami Florida's ATLANTIC COAST for an expansion, vertically elongated land region, approximately 3:4 composition. Reference one establishes pixel and miniature scale; reference two is the existing deep-blue ocean color. All surrounding empty space must be real alpha transparency. Only a narrow turquoise shallow-water and white surf fringe may stay attached to the shoreline. Land lies to LEFT/WEST, sea to RIGHT/EAST. Broad flat sandy subtropical land, never mountainous or fantasy cliffs. Irregular complete self-contained coastal vignette with a low rocky/soil cutaway bottom edge matching map reference, no square image bounds. Enough transparent padding around all sides.
Geography: bottom third / southeast shore holds a weathered abandoned military air-and-tank compound now kept running by two independent friendly pilots, Hotwire and Phoenix. Large concrete hangar with warm amber repair lights and a small cyan lit communications mast, battered perimeter seawall, little landing apron and short runway, spare tank repair shelters, generator and supply yard. A shore-facing entrance faces the open ocean to the right. Rust and encroaching palms show age, working lights show refuge, NO rebel/rogue/skull insignia. No people or ships necessary.
A clearly visible asphalt road exits the compound through its NORTH gate, runs north/up along the beach, curves inland LEFT toward a compact small Miami city district in the upper third: cream/pastel Art Deco facades, low-rise flat-roof buildings and a few muted tall buildings, not a giant skyline. Coastal highway is an unmistakable continuous route, white lane markings, palm trees, pale sand, mangrove patches, short tidal inlet bridge, turquoise beach water. Leave open inland space for later expansion nodes. Subtle small black-violet symbiotic creep OUTSIDE the defended compound and at distant urban edge hints the alien organism has spread, no huge alien fortress. Both compound and northbound highway visually legible at thumbnail scale. No separate insets or detached extra objects.
